How it works

Get your number. Go do what you need to do.

SmartQueue is for the in-between moments — the 20-minute wait before a document, the line at the cashier, the ID you need to claim. Join from your phone, then get on with your day.

01

Pick a service

Find the office you need, choose what you’re requesting, and check the current line.

02

Get your number

Your number joins the same line as walk-ins. No separate digital queue, no cutting ahead.

03

Come back when called

Track your place and get a notification when you’re next or when it’s time to head to the counter.

One central queue

Online or walk-in, it’s the same line.

Every entry point feeds one queue per service. If eight students are already waiting, the next digital ticket is number nine — not number one.

PWA / QR Walk-in / kiosk

R-018 R-019 R-020 R-021 R-024

Institutional context

Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Muntinlupa

Built around the places students already go.

SmartQueue is designed around PLMun’s campus offices — the Registrar, Finance Office, Office of Student Affairs, MIS Office, Guidance and Counseling, and the Medical and Dental Clinic. Office details come from the University’s public pages.

SmartQueuefor PLMun

A campus queue prototype for the Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Muntinlupa community. Built to make waiting less of a waste of time.

SmartQueue is an independent student prototype, not an official PLMun service. Queue numbers and live activity in this build are simulated.
